machine learning and data-mining methods have been developed and successfully applied to analyzing large amounts of genomic and expression data for charactering and modeling gene expression regulatory networks in model plant Arabdiopsis thaliana.

(1) data mining methods are very effective in modeling gene expression regulation, and in identifying gene expression patterns and regulatory networks; and (2) data mining methods can be used to develop new tools for analyzing large quantities of data for characterizing gene expression regulation and functions of gene regulatory networks.

the machine learning and data-mining methods can be used to analyze large quantities of genomic and gene expression data to model gene expression regulation and to identify gene responsive to environmental stress conditions and the functions of microRNAs.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and application of machine learning and data-mining methods for analyzing large amounts of gene expression data and genomic information to characterize and model the regulatory mechanisms of genes in plant responses to environmental stresses.
the development of data mining methods for modeling gene expression data and the application of these methods for analyzing gene expression regulation in model plant A. thaliana.

the development of machine learning and data analysis methods that can be used for analyzing large quantities of gene expression data, and for charactering the gene expression regulation underlying stress tolerance in plants.

data mining and machine learning approaches have been successfully used to characterize the regulatory mechanisms underlying gene expression and stress tolerance in plants.
the machine learning methods have been proven to be useful in the analysis of gene expression data and the characterization of gene regulation.
data mining and machine learning methods are useful for analyzing genomic and gene expression information and for characterizing gene functions and regulatory mechanisms.

we have been able to develop and apply machine learning and data-mining methods to analyze and characterize gene regulatory networks underlying abiotic stress tolerance in plants.

the data mining methods are very useful and effective for characterizing the complex regulatory network of gene expression in response to environmental stress and other stimuli.
